label: KarooFireFly
description: Automatic smart bike light control based on time of day and ambient light. Supports ANT+ lights (via Karoo pairing) and Magicshine BLE lights (via Bluetooth). Per-light configuration with protocol-specific modes, time-based and ambient light sensor automation, zone change notifications, and manual override via BonusActions.
releaseNotes:
* Magicshine BLE light support (Hori 1300, EVO 1700)
* Per-light profiles with protocol-specific modes
* Tap-to-configure light detail dialog with test buttons
* Battery and temperature readout for BLE lights
* Auto-off on pause option
* Protocol badges (ANT+/BLE) and connection status indicators
